description:
Safe function pointers in `gf2-kernels-simd` call `unsafe` kernels whose slice-shape preconditions are checked only by `debug_assert!`, so a release-build length mismatch reads or writes out of bounds from safe code. `@/inv/unsafe-kernel-isolation` requires an explicit safety contract at every unsafe boundary.

## Background

Reported wrappers: `bipedal/mod.rs` (`add_safe` through `neg_safe`), `bipedal/packed5.rs` (`add5_safe` through `neg5_safe`), `bipedal/packed7.rs` (the `*7_safe` family), `gf2m_gemm.rs` (`gf2m_gemm_panelized_safe`), `fp_small_ple.rs` and `fp_medium_ple.rs` (`ple_panel_base_safe`), and `fp_small.rs` (`SmallPrimeSpmmRowFn`, where `b` is unchecked).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every safe wrapper validates the slice shapes its kernel requires in release builds, or the entry is an `unsafe` function or an `_unchecked` path with a documented precondition per `@/inv/caller-trusted-fast-paths`.
- [hard] REQ-02: A release-profile test passes mismatched shapes to each safe wrapper and observes a panic or an error, never an out-of-bounds access.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each remaining `unsafe` block carries a `SAFETY:` comment naming the checked condition.
title: Safe kernel wrappers rely on debug-only shape checks
